goal: Checked source-level component declarations drive typed request/state binding and preservation in the existing connected simulation.
reuse: All17 published whole-cycle world/receipt projections remain unchanged, plus explicit per-operation component/core/input/result associations. Source S1 is the existing inline component; S2 extracts normalization into a named helper. No cost claim.

guards.fault: corrupt manual after actual pure return
corrupt indexed to a non-TextList after actual pure return

runtime_rules: Immutable checked source bytes and fixed alias-to-revision pins; never mutate a shared program dictionary
Receiver contract supplied independently; compatibility does not grant actual rights
Explicit transition hook receives whole intent and operation key; no hidden current-request global
Nominal request ID and base revision are built by the declared catalogue wire bridge and checked before pure transition
Result type revalidated through an existing typed identity programme; preservation uses fields returned by actual source checker
The old application-frame check remains a separate redundant workload contract; controls require the new declared-frame failure before it
Request/result associations are local observations with exact operation identity, not externally authenticated execution proof
limits: Only the typed core actually runs; receiver, authority and admission assumptions remain simulated
No real persistence, permissions or source execution profile change
Reused17 traces are regression/composition coverage, not17 new independent scenarios
Old logical work expectations are not copied to differently shaped new sources; compare declared values and retain actual charges without timing claims
